camera.permissionDenied: Camera permission denied. Please allow camera access and try again.
camera.accessError: Couldn't open the camera. Make sure no other app is using it, then try reconnecting.

scanEngine.searchFailed: Couldn't identify that card — try again

connectionFailed.title: Connection failed
connectionFailed.description: Couldn't open the connection. Make sure no other app is using the sorter.

noDeviceFound.title: No sorter found
noDeviceFound.description: Plug the sorter in over USB and try again. If it's already connected, make sure the cable supports data.

deviceTestFailed.title: Sorter test failed
deviceTestFailed.description: Connected but got no response. Try reconnecting.

testSkipped.title: Self-test skipped
testSkipped.description: The sorter's calibration didn't fully load, so the arms weren't moved. Open Calibrate to check all three sorting arms, then reconnect.

deviceRebooted.title: Sorter restarted unexpectedly
deviceRebooted.description: Calibration was re-sent and the self-test is running again.

reconnectFailed.title: Couldn't reconnect to the sorter
reconnectFailed.description: Check the USB cable, then click Connect.

strandedCardCleared.title: One card sent to the catch-all
strandedCardCleared.description: A card was mid-route when the sorter restarted, so it was dropped to the catch-all. Set it aside and re-run it.

resumeCheckFailed.title: Sorter recovered, but auto-feed stayed off
resumeCheckFailed.description: Couldn't confirm the card path is clear. Check for a stuck card, then turn auto-feed back on.

autoFeedTimeout.title: Auto-feed timeout
autoFeedTimeout.description: The feeder didn't respond in time.

feederEmpty.title: Hopper empty
feederEmpty.description: The hopper is out of cards — add more to continue.

noCollectionSelected.title: No collection selected
noCollectionSelected.description: Create or select a collection before scanning.

collectionLocked.title: Collection locked
collectionLocked.description: Someone else is scanning into this collection right now.

routingFailed.title: Routing failed
routingFailed.description: The sorter didn't respond while sending a card to bin {{binNumber}}.

routingFailedCatchAll.title: Routing failed
routingFailedCatchAll.description: The sorter didn't respond while sending a card to the catch-all bin (bin {{binNumber}}).

routingFailedReview.title: Routing failed
routingFailedReview.description: The sorter didn't respond while sending a card to the review bin (bin {{binNumber}}).

saveSessionFailed.title: Could not save the scan session
saveSessionFailed.description: {{reason}} Your scanned cards are still staged, so nothing was lost.
saveSessionFailed.noReason: The server did not say why.

discardSessionFailed.title: Could not discard the scan session
discardSessionFailed.noReason: The server did not say why.

sessionClosedMidScan.title: This scan session was already closed
sessionClosedMidScan.description: The run was saved or discarded while this card was being scanned, so the card was not kept. It has still been routed to its bin.

jamAutoScan.title: Card stuck at the camera — scanning it now
jamAutoScan.description: It hadn't been identified yet, so we scanned it automatically.

jamDetected.title: Card jam detected
jamDetected.description: Card stuck at sorting arm {{module}}. Clear it, then press Resume.
jamDetected.descriptionWithBin: Card stuck at sorting arm {{module}} on its way to bin {{bin}}. Clear it, then press Resume.

feedTimeout.title: Feed timeout
feedTimeout.description: The feeder didn't respond in time.

feederEmpty.title: Hopper empty
feederEmpty.description: The hopper is out of cards — add more to continue.

clearFailed.title: Clear failed
clearFailed.description: Couldn't send the command to the sorter.

clearTimeout.title: Clear timeout
clearTimeout.description: The sorter didn't respond in time.

deviceCleared.title: Sorter cleared
deviceCleared.description: Every gate was opened — check your bins for loose cards.

gameSwitchAlert.message: Different game, different card size — adjust the feeder's card guide before you start.

scanStats.emptyState: Scan cards to see their stats.

scannerOverlay.connectCamera: Connect a camera to start scanning.
scannerOverlay.noCatchAllBin: No catch-all bin set — cards that match nothing won't be sorted.
scannerOverlay.paused: Scanner paused — press Resume to continue.
scannerOverlay.duplicate: You already scanned this card — Add Again records another copy.
scannerOverlay.noMatch: Card not recognized — try Scan Again, or clean the card and check the lighting.

monitorSessions.releaseFailed: Couldn't stop the sort — try again
monitorSessions.title: Monitor
monitorSessions.subtitle: Watch a sort as it runs — anything live is at the top
monitorSessions.noSessionsHint: Start a sort from the Scanner and it'll show up here

serialPicker.title: Which USB device is your sorter?
serialPicker.description: More than one USB device is plugged in. Pick your sorter — it usually shows up as an Arduino.
serialPicker.remembered: This choice is remembered, so you will not be asked again for this device.
